---
title: "About"
description: "About James Hulse and this site."
---

I’m James Hulse, a data scientist based in Manchester. I work with data to understand transport, infrastructure and place, using tools including R, Python and spatial analysis.

This site is my space for publishing work in the open. Some pieces will be short notes; others will be full reproducible vignettes with code, data provenance, assumptions and interactive outputs. The aim is simple: make the route from question to conclusion visible.

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub](https://github.com/hulsiejames) — code, projects and contributions
- [OpenInfra](https://udsleeds.github.io/openinfra/) — collaborative work on open transport infrastructure data

Unless an article says otherwise, views expressed here are my own.
